title: Build valid IPv6 authorities for remote control WebSocket upgrades
description:
## Finding

The remote-control WebSocket Host/authority helper double-brackets IPv6 literals, so unary HTTP calls can work while event/attach upgrades fail.

## Evidence

* `crates/thegn-svc/src/control/client.rs:1091` takes `Url::host_str()` and brackets any host containing `:`.
* Parsed URL host strings for IPv6 are already bracketed in this path, producing an invalid authority such as `[[::1]]:8443`.
* The value is used for event and attach upgrades at `client.rs:705` and `:811`.

## Required design

Derive the authority from the URL/HTTP authority type rather than string heuristics. Preserve a single bracket pair for IPv6 and append only an explicit/non-default port according to HTTP rules.

## Acceptance criteria

* HTTP/HTTPS/WS/WSS origins with IPv4, DNS, and IPv6 (with and without explicit ports) serialize valid authorities.
* Unary and WebSocket transports target the same endpoint.
* Tests include `https://[::1]:8443` and scoped IPv6 forms where supported.
